Product fork (the body leaves it to the claimant): draw the statistic, not hide the option. A swimlane board shows the picked statistic once per column, across every swimlane, at the board's foot. The figure is the same whole-lane figure the flat board shows. The picker is unchanged. No per-cell (column × swimlane) figure is drawn, because the grouped read has no second grouping.
Scope (7188972467): on the rows-handed board, the swimlane column counts read the whole lane from the same grouped read, and the page counts are marked `+` while that read is refused, cut or pending. A swimlane row's own count, which no read groups, is marked `+` unless the page provably holds every lane's whole count.
Premise: holds on main e491fce2c. `LaneFootStatistic` is rendered only in `KanbanColumnView` (the flat layout). The swimlane layout draws no foot, and `ObjectKanban` asks the lane read only when `flatLanes` holds, so a swimlane board has no figure to draw. Its column-title row writes `laneCountLabel(col.cards.length, …)`, the page count, unmarked on a rows-handed board.
